text.text_excerpt: Cho Thai was good! This was my first time having Thai food, so I do not have a standard of judging its true essence of ethnicity, but based on just the experience and food, I have nothing horrible to say. As an appetizer, we had the crab claws. The sauce was amazing, and dipping the roti into the sauce was even better, omg! It was so great we ordered another roti to continue the awesomeness. The crab claws were very good also. Entrees: I ordered the Louisiana crab fried rice. The rice was a little stiff, as if it had been sitting a while, but the flavor mix made up for it. My date ordered the short rib Chiangmai noodle. He said it was good aside from the crispy shallots (personal preferen...

I had such a great experience from when the waiter first walked up until I left. The waiter was friendly, talkative and funny! He had so much knowledge about the food and drinks. The bird's eye view is the most popular drink, and my friend enjoyed it and ordered another! I had the midday dive and I highly recommend! I probably won't try anything else (I'm a creature of habit--if it' ain't broke don't fix it!). It's a strong drink, but not too strong. The food came quickly. It's about a standard portion size. I took a little bit of leftovers home. The crispy chicken was very good! Nice and juicy! Drunken noodles was cooked at Thai heat level, which is pretty spicy. Only order Thai spicy if...

I absolutely loved this place. The moment you walk in you're greeted with an aesthetically pleasing room full of great backdrops for photos. We went during the week and it was not busy at all. Staff followed Covid precautions and we were seated from others, which makes my Covid conscious self very happy. I felt very safe there. The food was AMAZINGGGGGGG. I loved everything that we had. The drunken noodles were my absolute favorite- I could eat them every day. If you're in the mood for a cocktail I would recommend trying their cocktail menu.
